context: Tests whether the agent refuses to propagate an undefined request ('good documentation summaries') into a finished prompt: vagueness is captured as explicit assumptions or clarifying questions, the prompt replaces vague terms with concrete requirements, defines an error-handling path for unclear input, and avoids unqualified quality words.

checklist.name: Gaps surfaced as assumptions or questions
checklist.description: assumptions.md states, for each key gap, either a concrete assumption or a clarifying question — no gap is just ignored.

checklist.name: Output requirements made concrete
checklist.description: The finished prompt defines what a summary must contain or how long it must be (e.g. max length, required elements), not just 'write a good summary'.

checklist.name: Input format specified
checklist.description: The prompt states what input the AI receives (e.g. raw technical documentation text) and how to process it.

checklist.name: Error handling path defined
checklist.description: The prompt states what to do when the input is unclear, empty, or invalid (e.g. ask for clarification, report invalid input).

checklist.name: Success is verifiable
checklist.description: The prompt defines how output quality is measured or validated (criteria the grader of the summary could check).

checklist.name: No undefined vague words
checklist.description: summary-prompt.md contains no unqualified 'good', 'better', 'properly', 'clearly' giving instructions without a definition attached.

checklist.name: Prompt file is a usable prompt
checklist.description: summary-prompt.md contains the finished prompt itself, ready to paste into an AI system — not notes about it.

checklist.name: Evidence files only
checklist.description: The working directory contains assumptions.md and summary-prompt.md as the deliverables (setup fixture may also exist).
